music.title: Music
music.setupIntro: Spotify requires each user to create their own developer "app" (it's free and takes 2 minutes). You need Spotify Premium.
music.step1: Go to the Spotify developer dashboard and click "Create app". Use any name and description you like.
music.step2: Under "Redirect URIs" add exactly this address:
music.step3: Under "Which API/SDKs are you planning to use?" tick "Web API", accept the terms and save.
music.step4: Open the app, go to "Settings" and paste the "Client ID" here:
music.moodsHint: When she switches to one of these moods she'll suggest its music. If you pick several playlists, she chooses one at random.
music.test_nodevice: Open Spotify on this PC or start playing on any device.
music.tastesHint: Edit "artistasFavoritos" and "artistasOdiados" in config/music.json. Her mischief music searches are there too.
music.errPort: Port 8977 is used by another program. Close it and try again.
music.errTimeout: Timed out waiting for the browser. Try again.
music.errClientId: Paste a valid Client ID (32 characters).
music.errInvalidClient: Spotify doesn't recognize the Client ID or the Redirect URI. Check that the address from step 2 was added exactly.
music.errForbidden: Spotify denied access. Check that your account is Premium and that the app is yours (or that you're in the app's "User Management").
